blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives for their first jump or participate in experienced skydiving activities including training and gear rental. The center operates from a private airport with a large landing area and amenities like a pro shop, deli, and lodging options. They offer coaching, team events, and have a full-service rigging loft and packing area.

quotes.author: Brian Worley
quotes.text: I can’t recommend SKYDIVE SPACELAND in San Marcos nearly enough! For years I debated skydiving, and I finally made the AMAZING jump to celebrate my 50TH birthday yesterday! It was truly one of the greatest, most exhilarating, and peaceful experiences I have ever had! Faz, Kellen and the entire staff were awesome and so easy to work with. From beginning to end there was no question they were the real deal, and never once did I feel pressured or that my questions or thoughts were being blown off or ignored. I am truly grateful for all of you, and I can’t wait to go back! 😎

quotes.author: Natalie M
quotes.text: A Thrill Beyond My Wildest Expectations! Oh my goodness! This tandem skydive was the experience of a lifetime! Everyone who worked at Skydive Spaceland were friendly, encouraging and professional. My tandem skydiver was Abraham, and my videographer was Tubbs. I'm sure not everyone's wait is the same, but my friend and I got there at 3pm, and we were finished by 4:30pm! I would strongly urge you to get the package that includes photos and videos, because it is so difficult to describe this incredible experience to friends and family who weren't there.
Took my daughter for her 18th birthday! Such an amazing experience! Friendly staff and very professional. Definitely would go back!
